dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple elliptical 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients, transitioning from a dark grey interior to a high-contrast off-white perimeter. The most prominent structures show irregular, slightly serrated outer boundaries with varying line thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters located along the superior dorsal ridge. Scattered, small-scale low-intensity dark clusters lacking internal gradients are densely distributed across the anterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent circular annuli on the mid-lateral flank define a trapezoidal geometric relationship. A secondary set of three annuli near the dorsal midline forms a tight, scalene triangular cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Deep, transverse dermal folds are visible in the posterior region, characterized by high-contrast linear shadowing within the skin creases.
